name: Ore no Kioku ni Kanojo wa Inai
original_name: 俺の記憶にカノジョはいない
source:
A girl appears in front of you, claiming to be your girlfriend. However, you don't remember having ever met her...

A mystery visual novel where the protagonist must find the clues about his missing memory.
